sources.methodology: Handselected exact translation-table meanings and source parts of speech, with explicit sourced preferences and exclusions in scripts/fetch-lexicon.py. Source grammar, register, and regional tags are retained. Chinese paired spellings and three explicitly normalized annotation fields retain their full sourceText. English studyText qualifiers distinguish selected homographs. Missing or uncertain translations stay missing. This dictionary-derived seed is not native-speaker reviewed, not a frequency list, and carries no CEFR assignments. Source POS describes the selected English dictionary sense; it is not a separately verified POS classification for every target-language form. Arabic verbs may use dictionary third-person perfect forms; some Asian adjective forms are attributive. The checked-in JSON freezes the selected forms and exact meaning/POS/source hash; rebuilding rejects changed source hashes unless --refresh is requested.
